Otago Polytechnic

Down here, learning is straight up useful.
Your teachers have time for you.

Whether you want to ask lots of questions or get one-on-one feedback, your teachers will work with you until you feel confident.

You’re learning the right stuff.

We work closely with industry to make sure you learn the skills employers look for, and to get you ready to step into a job.

Employers know you're ready for work.

Whether it’s in workshops, simulation labs, work placements, or client projects, you’ll get experience that reflects workplaces in your industry.

Start your study mid-year.

Get into it now. Programmes are starting soon – whether you’re keen for a career change, looking to upskill or starting fresh after a break.

Learn more

Explore all study options

Down here, we offer 150+ programmes. That’s straight up useful.

Straight from our students

“ OP understands the realities of working in the industry while studying, and supports students so no one feels isolated or left behind. ”
Jennifer Churchouse
Engineering
Jennifer's story
“ It was really hands-on and prepared us extremely well. It was down to our lecturers, who had worked in the industry and the industry connections. ”
Alex Broad
Lead Designer at Evolve Outdoors
Alex's story
“ My Pasifika mentor helped me feel a sense of connection and community at OP. It was nice to have a familiar face amongst the hustle and bustle of campus. ”
Matilda Garnett
Bachelor of Social Services
Matilda's story
